title: Shadow Becomes Me
summary: A playable laboratory stealth demo. Become a featureless shadow, disguise yourself as familiar shapes, and escape using Shadow Spike or a silent Shadow Devour.
summaryZhTW: 實驗室潛行試玩版。化為純黑暗影，變形為環境中的熟悉物件，運用暗影尖刺或無聲吞噬突破守衛，抵達出口。
coverAlt: Shadow Becomes Me — Playable Demo cover showing a black Shadow silhouette and a patrolling guard in an illuminated laboratory.
controls: A/D or arrow keys move; C or Transform cycles Shadow → Box → Chair → Shadow. X/Space or Spike triggers the contextual attack. Keyboard, mouse and touch supported.
limitations: Accepted single-laboratory proof of concept, not a complete campaign. Physical devices, Safari/Firefox and screen readers remain unverified.

approval.note: Owner accepted and closed Round 3 laboratory POC; separately authorized game and Possibility publication. Public deployment run 41282628622 and independent live verification recorded.
